_comment_secrets_and_per_deploy_values: The fields below are intentionally empty/absent here — see internal/pkg/utils/configurations.go for the `env:"..."` tag on each. They are injected as environment variables by the Helm charts in deployments/selfhost/helm (from Kubernetes Secrets or Vault) rather than baked into this file, so it can be committed without leaking credentials: MongoConnectionString (MONGO_CONNECTION_STRING), RedisAddress/RedisPassword (REDIS_ADDRESS/REDIS_PASSWORD), NATSURL (NATS_URL), VaultAddr/VaultToken/VaultTransitKeyName (VAULT_ADDR/VAULT_TOKEN/VAULT_TRANSIT_KEY_NAME — VaultToken stays empty, the Vault Agent Injector supplies one), KindeIssuerURL/KindeAudience (KINDE_ISSUER_URL/KINDE_AUDIENCE), ResendApiKey (RESEND_API_KEY), StripeSecretKey/StripeWebhookSecret/StripePriceID* (STRIPE_*), TokenGenKey (TOKEN_GEN_KEY), BundleVerificationKey (BUNDLE_VERIFICATION_KEY), SlackToken (SLACK_APP_TOKEN), ContactApiToken (CONTACT_API_TOKEN), ServingBaseURL/ControlBaseURL (SERVING_BASE_URL/CONTROL_BASE_URL). TestingEnvironment and SimulationSecret are deliberately left unset — they are dev/test-only escape hatches (see their doc comments in configurations.go) and must stay unset in production.
